output.reasoning: No live market data (CME FedWatch, SOFR futures) is available to me as of 2026-10-29, so this is a judgment-based prior. The Oct 27-28 meeting just concluded the day before this query; the Dec 8-9 meeting is next. Base rates for FOMC decisions heavily favor either a 25bp move or a hold; 50bp moves are reserved for stress/crisis conditions and are rare. Assuming 2026 has been a gradual easing cycle (the dominant narrative into late 2026), the modal outcome is a 25bp cut, with a meaningful chance of a hold if inflation progress stalls or labor data stays firm. I place small residual mass on a 50bp cut (only if labor market deteriorates sharply) and minimal mass on hikes, which would require a clear inflation re-acceleration surprise. Distribution leans toward a 25bp cut but keeps substantial weight on no change given data-dependence and meeting-to-meeting caution.
